chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from Yunus, from the one whom he mentioned, from Abu Baseer, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Abu Muhammad! Indeed, for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, are angels who cast off sins from the backs of our Shias, just as the wind casts leaves from the tree in the season of their falling.'
And that is His statement, Mighty and Majestic: 'They glorify with the praise of their Lord...'
And they ask forgiveness for those who believe. By Allah, He did not intend by this other than you.
ai.seo_question: Who are the angels that remove sins from the Shia according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that Allah has appointed specific angels to expiate the sins of the Shia, employing the vivid metaphor of wind shedding leaves from trees to illustrate the ease and completeness of this divine forgiveness. He explicitly links this promise to Quran 40:7, asserting that the 'those who believe' mentioned in the verse specifically refers to the Shia, thereby establishing their unique spiritual status in Shia exegesis.

en.hubeali: H 14918 – Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abdullah Bin Al-Salt, from Yunus, from the one whom he mention, from Abu Baseer who said:

Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Angels who cut off the sins from the backs of ourasws Shites just like the cutting by the wind of the leaves from the tree in the season of autumn
and that is the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[40:7] hymn the praises of their Lord
and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe”, and Allahazwj has not Intended by this other than you’.
en.sarwar: 471. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Zurara who said, ‘Narrated to me Abu Al-Khattab in the best of conditions that:
He asked Abu Abdullah (a.s.) about the Statement of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic:
“[39:45] And when Allah alone is mentioned,

(the Imam (a.s.) said it is) by the obedience to the one (a.s.), the obedience to whom (a.s.) Allah (azwj) the One has Commanded for from the Progeny (a.s.) of Muhammad (saww) the hearts of those who do not believe in the hereafter shrink, and when there is a mention of the one, the obedience to whom Allah (azwj) has not Commanded for lo! they are joyful”.
